source_text: ![Supreme Court of India][float-right] On October 11, 2025, Chief Justice of India B.R. Gavai publicly acknowledged the practice of female genital mutilation (FGM) in India, condemning it as a grave human rights violation and calling for stronger legal protections for girls. [64] [65]
